ITS offers a generative AI platform available to all active U-M faculty, staff, and students on the Ann Arbor, Flint, and Dearborn campuses and Michigan Medicine. These service offerings, which include U-M GPT, U-M Maizey, and U-M GPT Toolkit, are secure, private, equitable, accessible, and free. They support everything from basic consumer usage to advanced research and experimentation.

Regardless of the physical location from which you access or use the Services, which shall be limited to use within the United States, you will be considered to be accessing or using information technology of U-M.

Our most accessible ITS AI service is U-M GPT, a conversational AI tool that provides access to popular hosted AI models such as Azure OpenAI, GPT-Image-1, and U-M hosted open-source large language models.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Google Gemini is a generative AI chat and image generation app available to all University of Michigan faculty, staff, and students. (Sponsored affiliates, alumni, and retirees do not have access to Gemini.) Like U-M’s GenAI services, Gemini can be used to create new content, generate and edit images (using Nano Banana), help brainstorm ideas, draft or summarize writing, explore complex topics, and assist with research and creative work. You can connect and use some Google Workspace services within the Gemini web app.

Google Gemini can be used for certain kinds of sensitive data, as detailed in the Sensitive Data Guide to IT Services.
You can access Gemini via the web app at https://gemini.google.com or mobile app (Android and iOS).
Learn more about Google Gemini features, access and support resources.
Gemini Notebook
Google Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) is an AI-powered research and note-taking assistant available to all University of Michigan faculty, staff, and students. (Sponsored affiliates, alumni, and retirees do not have access to Gemini Notebook.) Using Google's Gemini models, Gemini Notebook lets you upload your own sources, such as documents, PDFs, and Google Docs, and interact with the

m through summaries, questions, audio overviews, flashcards, AI-assisted exploration, and more. It is especially helpful for synthesizing large amounts of information across uploaded materials.
Google Gemini Notebook can be used for certain kinds of sensitive data, as detailed in the Sensitive Data Guide to IT Services.
You can access Gemini Notebook via the web app at https://notebook.google.com or mobile app (Android and iOS).

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Adobe Firefly is available for free through the University of Michigan's enterprise Adobe Creative Cloud license to all University of Michigan faculty, staff, and students. Firefly is a family of creative generative AI models used to generate, edit, and refine visual and audio content. It is designed specifically for commercial safety and is built directly into Adobe applications like Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere, as well as being accessible as a standalone web tool.
